# OptmizeImage

> Free online image compressor to reduce file size without losing quality.

OptmizeImage.com is a free, browser-based online tool designed to help users compress various image formats, including JPG, PNG, and WebP, to specific file size targets like 100KB, 200KB, or 500KB. It prioritizes user privacy by performing all compression directly in the browser, eliminating the need for file uploads. This service is ideal for web developers, content creators, and anyone needing to optimize images for faster website loading, reduced storage, or to meet specific platform requirements.

The core value proposition lies in its ease of use, speed, and privacy. Users can quickly reduce image file sizes without sacrificing visual quality significantly, making websites more performant and user-friendly. Key use cases include preparing images for web deployment, email attachments, or social media sharing where file size limits are common. The site also offers educational content on image optimization best practices, helping users understand the impact of image compression on web vitals and SEO.
